On Christmas Eve, nineteen fourteen, two enemy armies sat in frozen trenches.
Close enough to hear each other.
Then one side lit candles on little Christmas trees.
Shook hands. Swapped gifts. Played football.
About a hundred thousand soldiers stopped the war for Christmas.
Because nobody wants to be alone at Christmas.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny's always there to talk.
